purpose: Cover AC-16001-1 (supersededBy broken pointer surfaces as brokenReference with field=supersededBy) and AC-16001-2 (relatedAdrs unknown entry surfaces as brokenReference with field starting relatedAdrs). The tests scaffold a fresh RCF project with initProject, mutate adr-001.json to point at a non-existent ADR id, then walkTree and assert the brokenReference entry.
title: referee-validate ADR cross-link walker: AC-16001-1 supersededBy broken, AC-16001-2 relatedAdrs unknown

testCases.description: Fresh project via initProject; set adr-001.json supersededBy to ADR-999; walkTree; assert errors contain a brokenReference with documentId=ADR-001 and field=supersededBy.
testCases.testPointer: test/store/walker.test.js::walkTree flags an ADR with a broken supersededBy pointer as brokenReference (REQ-160 AC-16001-1)

testCases.description: Fresh project via initProject; set adr-001.json relatedAdrs to [ADR-777]; walkTree; assert errors contain a brokenReference with documentId=ADR-001 whose field starts with relatedAdrs.
testCases.testPointer: test/store/walker.test.js::walkTree flags an ADR with an unknown id in relatedAdrs as brokenReference (REQ-160 AC-16001-2)
